# AFTER THE FORK

# AT THIS MOMENT ALL ACCOUNTS ARE UNBLOCKED.
friends, we were forced to make a fork from 53964 to 24280.
From index 24281 to 53964, 13,000 blocks were identified whose data
did not match the hash of the block, thus the data sent to the blockchain
were not mined, nor were their transactions, how did the hash not match and the entire chain was
broken. This attack was carried out by a group of addresses using private applications.

Due to the fact that we could not leave it as it is, as it is
no exchange would accept blocks with a broken chain, we are forced
were to make a rollback.

To achieve fairness, I divided all accounts into three groups.
1. Honest miners, they suffered the most.
2. Accounts that received coins regardless of the origin of the coins,
    also maintain your balance.
3. All scammers will lose their stolen money.
4. Also, all accounts that have committed fraud more than 10 times are blocked
    and will be unable to mine blocks or spend their money for an indefinite period of time.

This punishment is implemented not only on the server, but also on all wallets.
Due to their actions, we lost more than 30,000 blocks, which greatly affected
on honest miners, and also prevented honest miners from mining coins.

Below I will give each account of how much he stole, as well as the number of crimes committed.
About 175 addresses were implicated in the crime.

No
